title.zh: 一键去水印 vs 手动涂抹：两种去除水印方式的实际效果对比
title.en: One-Click vs Manual: Comparing Two Watermark Removal Approaches

description.zh: 深入对比watermarkcleaner.com与Magic Eraser.org两款主流AI去水印工具，从操作便捷性、全屏水印处理能力、画质保护效果和商用适用性四大维度，为不同需求的用户提供科学选择依据。
description.en: An in-depth comparison of watermarkcleaner.com and Magic Eraser.org from four key dimensions: ease of use, full-screen watermark handling, image quality preservation, and commercial applicability.
